$comment: Sources SAP BTP must refuse (D91). Each case is the business object of `rapt new <dir> Item --prefix <prefix>` with exact text replacements in the file whose name ends with the key; {prefix} is the prefix in lower case. `expect.code`: the diagnostic of `rapt check` in standard mode (null: accepted). `sap`: the outcome on SAP BTP, from the round trip (`scripts/btp-roundtrip.mjs --negative`): `refuses` with the exact message, `activates`, or null when not yet tried. `confirm`: what the round trip must settle.

cases.description: The business object of rapt new, unchanged: SAP activates it.
WRITE, a statement of classic ABAP, in a handler method.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
WRITE 'x'.
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

cases.description: SELECT on MARA, a table not released for ABAP for Cloud Development.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
SELECT SINGLE matnr FROM mara INTO @DATA(material).
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

cases.description: CALL FUNCTION of a function module not released for ABAP for Cloud Development.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
CALL FUNCTION 'POPUP_TO_CONFIRM'.
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

cases.description: A value written to sy-subrc, read-only in ABAP for Cloud Development.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
sy-subrc = 0.
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

sap.message: Only reads can be performed on the field "SY-SUBRC" in the current ABAP language version.

cases.description: A field of the behavior definition the CDS entity does not have.
A mapping to a column the persistent table does not have.
A root entity without lock master.
A determination without its handler method.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
METHODS setStatus FOR DETERMINE ON MODIFY
      IMPORTING keys FOR Item~setStatus.

cases.confirm: SAP may only warn that the determination has no implementation.

cases.description: DELETE on the persistent table in a handler method, outside the save sequence.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
DELETE FROM {prefix}_item WHERE status = 'X'.
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

cases.confirm: SAP may accept it at activation and stop it at runtime (BEHAVIOR_ILLEGAL_STATEMENT).

cases.description: COMMIT WORK in a handler method.

_r_item.clas.locals_imp.abap:
COMMIT WORK.
    CHECK instances IS NOT INITIAL.

cases.confirm: Open RAP Runtime accepts it today; SAP may refuse it at activation (strict mode) or at runtime only.

cases.description: COUNT(*) in the select list of a view entity without GROUP BY (D105, D111).

_r_item.ddls.asddls:
status                as Status,
      status                as Status,
      count(*)              as Total,

cases.description: The session variable $session.bs_system_id in a view entity (D103, D111).

_r_item.ddls.asddls:
status                as Status,
      status                as Status,
      $session.bs_system_id as SystemId,

cases.confirm: SAP documents $session.bs_system_id, bs_instance_id and bs_zone_id for view entities: if it activates, Open RAP Runtime supports them (the system, the instance, the zone of the server).
